They differ in mode and lane: Pangaea moves ocean dry bulk cargo worldwide with ice-class vessels. J.B. Hunt does North American intermodal, trucking, brokerage and last-mile delivery. The service category overlaps, but the offerings and shipper types do not. That makes it adjacent, not a direct competitor.

T:P1.3.text: Pangaea is a global provider of comprehensive maritime logistics and transportation solutions. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its clients by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities. We not only own and operate a large fleet of bulk carriers, including high ice class vessels but we design, produce and operate port and inland projects.

T:P1.5.text: No two projects are the same. We customize each project based on our client's specific needs. Our attention to detail is critical in forming lasting relationships. If you have a need, we will find a solution.

T:P1.6.text: Almost 50% of our owned fleet is made up of Ice Class 1A vessels. We have pioneered both the Northern Sea Route and the Northwest Passage resulting in lower CO2 emissions, fewer days at sea and substantial fuel savings.

T:P1.8.text: We have expertise in the development and expansion of port facilities; specifically loading and discharging operations. We recently completed a loading port in Newfoundland and the expansion of a port terminal in Charleston, S.C.

T:P1.10.text: We have extensive experience in handling cargoes like DRI A, B & C. We educate and train our crew to avoid any issues while carrying these complex cargoes. SAFETY is always our #1 priority.

T:P2.3.text: Pangaea is a US-based maritime logistics and transportation company utilizing its expertise to service a broad base of customers who require the transportation of a wide variety of dry bulk cargoes. The Company addresses the logistics needs of its customers by undertaking a comprehensive set of services and activities that seeks to add value at every step of the supply chain.

T:P2.4.text: The Company operates a fleet of approximately 45-60 Supramax, Panamax and Handymax vessels, of which 40 are owned or partially owned. The Company is a leader in the high ice class sector, secured by its control of a majority of the world’s large dry bulk vessels with Ice-Class 1a designation.

C:P1.1.text: Logistics Services and Freight Shipping | J.B. Hunt

C:P1.2.text: Our mode-neutral shipping solutions make moving freight easy. We're creating the most efficient transportation network in North America.

C:P1.3.text: Read our latest white paper: Structural Forces Reshaping the Freight Market

C:P1.4.text: Change the way you do business with the J.B. Hunt 360 °® platform. We're eliminating inefficiencies by creating one place for you to manage every step of the transportation process.

C:P1.6.text: Access to thousands of qualified carriers

C:P1.7.text: Take advantage of the cost-effective and sustainable solutions from North America’s leading intermodal provider.

C:P1.8.text: Move over-the-road shipments with flexibility and efficiency through our J.B. Hunt 360box® drop-and-hook solution.

C:P1.9.text: Receive access to nationwide reach, visibility into performance, streamline shipments and more with less-than-truckload (LTL).

C:P1.10.text: Get best-in-class safety, route planning and optimization capabilities for your dedicated fleet when you work with J.B. Hunt teams.

C:P1.11.text: We’ve got you covered from the first mile all the way through last-mile deliveries to homes and job sites.

C:P1.12.text: Get customized support, supply chain visibility and seamless transloading service with over-the-road and rail options available.

C:P1.13.text: Get a provider that creates a custom supply chain for your business and handles the day-to-day operations for you.

C:P1.14.text: Get the capacity you need for your over-the-road freight, supported by thousands of qualified third-party carriers.

C:P1.15.text: That's why we have a passionate pursuit of excellence and are always striving for more. We listen, innovate and invest in order to provide you with excellence. J.B. Hunt is driven for you.

C:P1.16.text: "Technology in the global transportation space to me means real-time visibility and the 360 platform does a very nice job of providing that for me."

C:P1.17.text: Director of Global Transportation and Trade Compliance at a global fishing company

C:P1.18.text: "J.B. Hunt takes the time up front to really get to know our business, our pain points and then customize a tailored solution to meet those."

C:P1.19.text: Chief Executive Officer for a wholesale hardware and industrial supplies distributor

C:P2.1.text: Our Company | Creating Transportation Efficiency | J.B. Hunt

C:P2.2.text: J.B. Hunt provides a variety of freight transportation services to customers throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

C:P2.3.text: We got our start with five trucks, seven trailers and Mr. Hunt’s vision to create something big. We’ve grown a lot but our legacy of innovation and impact lives on. Together, we’re working toward our vision to create the most efficient transportation network in North America.

C:P2.4.text: "To get where we’re gonna go, it takes all of us. I can’t do it, you can’t do it, but we can do that."

C:P2.5.text: Our vision is to create the most efficient transportation network in North America. This statement keeps us focused on the future and what we’re aspiring for as a company. It encourages us to not only innovate solutions that make our company better, but to find ways to improve the greater supply chain.
